name: Scoped service credentials
summary: Issue, verify, expire and revoke secret service credentials.
use_when: An application admits authenticated machine requests.
proposed_guarantees: Exact owner/resource binding and explicit required scopes
Issue-once random secrets with stored SHA-256 verifiers
Mandatory expiry and revocation checked on every verification request; work already admitted may finish
Atomic create-without-overwrite and binding-checked durable revoke
Local bbolt adapter uses bounded lock waits on supported local filesystems
SQL adapter targets PostgreSQL-compatible servers for multi-host storage via application-owned database/sql
Sanitized metadata listing; issuance cannot exceed a caller-authorized ceiling
failure_modes: Storage unavailable or corrupt: verification fails closed
Already admitted work may finish after revocation
Caller supplies an untrusted issuance ceiling or skips resource authorization
bbolt local storage is not a distributed or multi-host database

evidence.basis: Candidate boundary informed by maintainer source inspection; identifying evidence is not published.
Candidate lifecycle, bbolt and PostgreSQL-compatible SQL adapters, contract tests and public-source provenance are available for review. Test fixtures alone are not consumer adoption.
An earlier local integration was reported by the maintainer; its source and artifacts are restricted. It establishes no public AMSL adoption, merged release or production deployment.

A concurrent private-application helper and integration test adopt servicecred/sqlstore for new credentials while legacy tokens remain on the product path. Local branch only; not a merged release or production wire-up.
Public consumer pull request wires servicecred/boltstore behind serve --keystore with Issue/Verify/Revoke tests. Open PR is not a merged release or production deployment.

alternatives.name: Go crypto/rand
alternatives.assessment: Use standard cryptography; AMSL may own the lifecycle integration.

alternatives.name: Existing public scoped-key and bbolt storage implementation
alternatives.assessment: Attributed persistence-pattern extraction; owner/resource authority, mandatory expiry and storage errors require an explicit hardened contract.

alternatives.name: SereneDB
alternatives.assessment: PostgreSQL-compatible server; sqlstore swaps via driver and DSN without a vendor-specific AMSL package.

open_questions: Human maintainer review of the security API and source/adoption evidence is pending; retain CANDIDATE.
